notes: 5000 iid equal-weight draws from an explicitly transported domain law, not a reconstruction of surveyed individuals. Original full relevant pages read. Uses crude source 2x2 counts, NOT its adjusted OR. Canadian uncorrected reproductive-age ferritin prevalence supplies the marginal anchor. Source conditional anemia risks are held invariant while ferritin prevalence changes: a strong, unverifiable China-to-US transport assumption. Saturating Hb response, raw-ferritin inflation, independent non-iron Hb component and reporting precision are chosen assumptions. Continuous dependence, including Spearman, is not identified by the binary evidence. Population-law quadrature calibration precedes sampling; no realized moments, seeds or counts are forced. No claim of target validation.

omissions_and_ambiguities: Original labeled wide geometric-mean CIs are retained as reported and not used as SDs or mean/SE data.
Original adjusted OR and folate–B12 correlation are not used as crude OR or Hb–ferritin correlation.
No restriction or correction for CRP. Latent storage variable is a model device; output is raw ferritin.
Full-text request for PMC11522960 was screened out; no content from that rejected source was obtained or used.
No target records or target outcome summaries accessed. Complete-measurement/pregnancy-known inclusion and phlebotomy weighting are assumed transportable into the chosen domain law.

parameter_provenance.rationale: User output contract; iid equal-weight rows integrate over unobserved covariates, rather than simulating sampling weights.

parameter_provenance.transfer: Holds Canadian19–50 female prevalence fixed for the US20–44 nonpregnant complete-measurement phlebotomy-weighted domain2021–23. Assumes survey inclusion, pregnancy exclusion, age, geography, era, diet, race/ethnicity and assay differences do not change marginal raw deficiency. Not identified.

Transport both crude conditional risks across China2004 to target despite IUD/postpartum, diet, supplement, comorbidity, ethnic and inflammatory differences. Crude rather than causal invariance. Consequently population-law OR=173*1082/(85*331), joint=0.182*173/504 and anemia=0.182*173/504+0.818*85/1167 before Monte Carlo error.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Finite-moment right-skewed ferritin mixture; inflammation can elevate raw ferritin without improving available iron. 1.0 log-SD,20% mixture and2-fold multiplier not empirically identified. mu_f is DERIVED by brentq solving 0.8*Phi((ln14.95-mu_f)/1)+0.2*Phi((ln14.95-mu_f-ln2)/1)=0.182.
parameter_provenance.setting: log latent storage ferritin ~ Normal(mu_f,1.0^2); inflammation I~Bernoulli0.20 independent; raw F=exp(logStore+I*log2)

parameter_provenance.rationale: Smooth iron restriction approaching plateau at sufficient stores; halfpoint7ug/L and exponent2 chosen, not fitted from ambiguous original intervals. Supports low-ferritin Hb association without linear growth of Hb at high stores.

Residual HbSD0.9g/dL, inflammatory decrement0.3g/dL and independent other-cause component3% with2g/dL decrement model variation not explained by storage iron, including non-iron anemia; not transported empirical frequencies. No separate assay noise added because residual includes measurement error.
parameter_provenance.setting: Hb|S,I,O ~ Normal(H-D*g(S)-0.3*I-2.0*O,0.9^2) truncated below0; O~Bernoulli0.03 independent

parameter_provenance.rationale: Unique numerical root used by program matching two transported conditional anemia risks under the chosen population law, with D=exp(logD). Deterministic 160-node Gauss–Legendre integration over each ferritin stratum, inflammation and other-cause mixture. Root initial13.6,ln3 is numerical start only. No sample-derived calibration.
Chosen reporting precision, not verified target assay precision; boundary shift DERIVED to preserve strict reported thresholds after rounding. Ties retained for average-rank analysis.
parameter_provenance.setting: Hb and ferritin rounded to0.1g/dL and0.1ug/L respectively; latent thresholds11.95 and14.95

parameter_provenance.rationale: Each seed draws a cohort from same finite-moment law. Empirical CI and large transport/structural uncertainties not converted into new empirical information by repeated virtual people.
parameter_provenance.setting: All population parameters fixed across seeds
